title: How the French left wants to reclaim the idea of the nation

title: Delphine Horvilleur, rabbi: 'After October 7, it took me time to speak about the suffering of innocent Palestinians'

title: 'The Trump plan changed nothing': One year later, Gaza still lives in ruins, under bombs
subhead: Three years after the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, residents of the Palestinian territory continue to live among rubble.
